## Standing note

Item tags are **Trial** (sandbox, demo, one-off, MoU or signing) or **Operating** (recurring public or commercial service). Sandbox counts and corridor status live on [Official status](tracker.qmd). Item lines below focus on the use case — they do not restate those baselines.

## How to read the source tags

- **Company-announced:** the company’s own claim.
- **Independently reported:** a news outlet’s own reporting.
- **Officially confirmed:** confirmed in a linked official release or document.

**As of 11 Oct 2026:** 38 use-case items on this page (28 trial · 10 operating). Live window colour draws on the Sep–Oct 2026 snapshot; the archive covers Oct 2025 onward.

- []{#uc-item-2026-10-08-zhuhai .uc-item}**8 Oct 2026 · C114 / China Unicom Zhuhai feature:** Zhuhai Agriculture Investment Holding, Guangdong Chaofei Technology and China Unicom Zhuhai sign strategic cooperation for a sea-island UAV livelihood-supply pilot framed around Zhuhai’s 262 islands. [C114](https://m.c114.com.cn/w84-1318768.html)
  - Status: **Trial** · Domain: Delivery · Geography: GBA (Zhuhai)
  - Tag: Company-announced
  - What's happening: Signing / pilot-preparation via the Unicom feature. Stated division of labour and 5G + BeiDou framing are plans. Route count, aircraft type, payload and frequency are not published.
  - Note: Strategic cooperation only — not live commercial island routes.
  - Read instead: None.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「近日，珠海市农业投资控股集团有限公司、广东超飞科技有限公司、中国联通珠海市分公司举行海岛无人机民生保供项目战略合作签约。」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://m.c114.com.cn/w84-1318768.html))
  :::

  - Read instead: None.
